value: **Involvement**: Teachers collaborated as design partners in collaborative design sessions to provide pedagogical domain expertise, define requirements, evaluate usability, and iteratively refine educational technology tools and online learning environments. **Evidence**: "Central to this approach is engaging comm unity stakeholders —educators, families, policymakers, youth—in co-designing representations and modeling potential futures for local ecosystems."
